plan.notes: Official NJIT 2026-2027 catalog page 'B.S. in Electrical Engineering', 4-year Plan of Study Grid (120 credit minimum; catalog prints Total Credits 120). Co-op Option A and B tracks on the same page were not transcribed. Second-year first semester has one unlabeled 3-credit row; recorded as a History and Humanities GER 200-level placeholder (the 2024-2025 archived edition labels this slot 'History and Humanities GER 200 level'). Third-year first semester has one 3-credit choice slot with catalog options MGMT 390, IE 492, ECON 201, ECON 265, ECON 266. Fourth year: the catalog grid leaves the elective rows unlabeled; they are encoded as EE Track/Technical Elective choice slots and one 2-credit Track Laboratory slot, per the catalog's 'Electrical Engineering Track and Track Laboratory' section (students select one track) and 'Electrical Engineering Technical Electives - 3 courses' rule (300/400-level ECE or advisor-approved upper-level course; ECE 368, ECE 421, and ECE 410 excluded). ECE 416 or ECE 417 is the catalog's capstone choice. Per-term sums verified against the catalog's printed Term Credits (16/14/16/15/15/17/13/14 = 120).
